edbDesc: The sum of the attractive or repulsive forces between molecules (or between parts of the same molecule) other than those due to covalent bonds or to the electrostatic interaction of ions with one another or with neutral molecules. Includes Keesom Force, Debye Force and London dispersion force.
title: Van der Waals Force
pickWhy: The deck's gas-laws card is van der Waals's 1873 work on the small attraction between molecules.
